title: A feedback item answered with a found gap must name its home
why: fb-1238-1 (Nov 11 12:40 CST) found the size check counts the wrong thing, but was closed "answered in chat" with no step, so nobody owned the fix; the owner met the same mistake again on Nov 13 at 11:00 CST.
source: retrospective 11:02 CST Nov 13; owner 11:00 and 11:01 CST
note: The feedback check refuses a "question -> answered" item whose answer names a defect or gap ("gap", "wrong", "broken", "missing", "stale", or a proposed fix) unless the item also names a step, debt or ruling home. Red case: fb-1238-1. Express (ruling drain-first-hold part 4: a fix that tracks work goes ahead of the drain). Cost: one more pattern check inside the feedback check already running; no new process or log. Express lane started 12:45 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 12:45 CST): lane feedback-guard-findings, session_013NEJL3fTMNnVHbgiss5Vcp. Limits reported 14:33 CST Nov 13 with #3221 (handed to runner 10, lint PASS; lane session_013NEJL3fTMNnVHbgiss5Vcp), unread by triage: DEFECT_WORDS has no negator exemption ("nothing is wrong" blocks); the check reads the guard's own ` repeats <ref>` mark, so `repeats debt:stale-flags` blocks; a `**answered**`-wrapped home word skips the check (same as closed_problem); an older defect-word question item in a standing inbox blocks until reworded. Notes, no debt unless ruled.
